newsitem.title: ITALY: MINIMUM RATE 6.96 PCT AT ITALY LIRA REPO TENDER.
newsitem.headline: MINIMUM RATE 6.96 PCT AT ITALY LIRA REPO TENDER.

text.p: The minimum rate at Friday's 5.0 trillion lire 10-day Bank of Italy repurchase tender was 6.96 percent, compared with 6.77 percent at the previous repo tender on August 4, the Bank said.
The average rate was 6.98 percent against 6.79 percent at the last repurchase pact for 9.0 trillion lire and 25 days.
The pact covers purchases today and the securities are for resale on August 18. The Bank said it received 40 bids of which eight were met in full and four in part.
